data.name: Tactical Gear Mod
data.shortDescription: This configurable client-side mod adds tactical gear to you and any other players in your game.
data.description: This mod adds lots of options related to cosmetic tactical gear, for both you and for co-op players. It's client-side meaning only you will see any changes on you or on others, but your friends can download the mod to see it too :) Check the mod settings to configure it to your taste. Settings are applied in certain specific circumstances, so expect to reload/rejoin to fully notice changes. It even works with the game's outfits! (Helmet mileage may vary, expect it to clip with armor if unhidden) Full options list: - Tactical vest - Helmet (dead corpse “hemlet” model by default) - FAST/Cutscene helmet model swap (requires helmet to be enabled) - Name tags for other players (displays Steam usernames, works best if you disable visible world icons in SOTF’s settings) - Hide backpacks (for a cleaner look) - Gloves (for first-person and co-op players) - "Old jacket" option, like Kelvin and cutscene guys wear. This is the only clothing piece that was designed for the gloves. - Balaclavas and/or sunglasses (to look like the intro pilot) - Hide equipped armor pieces (such as creepy or bone armor) - Option to give Kelvin his helmet back The binoculars break the first-person gloves, but changing outfits fixes them. Your PlayerLocation patch method worked, thank you GLaD0S, I love you <3 https://github.com/clairenheit/ArmorMod

versions.changelog:
Actually fixed the constraint source issue
 Fixed bald players breaking the code
Applied more fixes for the name tag constraint issue, including null checks so if the issue occurs it shouldn't halt the code
Fixed an issue with the nametag constraint source that prevented some options from appearing on network players
Added setting to disable visibility of equipped armor pieces, such as Bone or Creepy armor.
Fixed the local glove and Kelvin helmet code being parented under the backpack option, oops!
Fixed some issues that slipped through for network players, their options will appear properly now

Added lots of new options
- Gloves replacer, for hands (for local and network players)
- Balaclava and sunglasses options (network players, balaclava type unfortunately limits race system to White and Latin to avoid clipping)
- Kelvin-type jacket replacer option (local and network players, also supports outfits)
- Added config options to disable the tactical vest and name tag features, if desired
Other
- Refactored code to fix issues with 3+ players and simplify asset references
- Fixed backpacks reappearing after outfit change
- Various other fixes
Fixed mesh so that scale fixes are no longer required! The mod will no longer cause any camera or cutscene oddities as it no longer modifies the player skeleton.
Added Steam username name tags on other players' vests
Fixed missing LocalPlayer check for helmet code

- Added option to hide backpacks of other players, for that real Trailer 1 look
- Added automatic hair remover if you have a helmet enabled

Added helmets and some settings
- Toggle helmet (defaults to on)
- Use cutscene model, which switches the helmet model (defaults off due to jank chin strap)
These settings only apply when player models are spawned, I.E. when players first join
Forgot to disable elevated logging
Added a lot of different checks to help eliminate most remaining animation issues
Fixed every instance of the cutscene cameras I could find except for the intro wakeup scene
Added actually functional Kelvin helmet option this time

Fixed chin strap on Cutscene Helmet
Added option to enable Kelvin's intro cutscene helmet
Fixed translation offset of name tag
Removed leftover scale patch and fixed helmet appearing on LocalPlayer.
Fixed the crafting animation bug
First release
